title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces updates
description: With new Copilot Workspaces updates, Work IQ can suggest relevant workspaces based on current workstreams to help people get started quickly. Once in a workspace, team members can work together on shared documents while Copilot connects the dots across the work, surfacing what changed, what remains unresolved, and which actions need attention so everyone can quickly catch up and keep the work moving.
